text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Rally in Australia denounces crime of sanctions on Iraq and condemns U.S. policy towards Baghdad.
- Ship loaded with cooking oil arrives at the southern port of Umm Qasr.
- British organisation condemns U.N. arms inspection teams.
- Iraq and Egypt review bilateral relations.
- Delegation of Syrian pharmaceutical companies arrives in Baghdad.
- Yemeni President calls for the lifting of sanctions on Iraq.
- Article on the double standard policy pursued by the United States.
- Article on U.S. commitments towards Israeli security.
- Wool factories achieve 25 percent increase in production.
